sql:
SELECT
    d.NorthAmericaSeason,
    avg(daily_sales) AS avg_daily_sales
FROM
(
    SELECT
        fs.DateKey,
        dd.NorthAmericaSeason,
        sum(fs.SalesAmount) AS daily_sales
    FROM retail.FactSales AS fs
    INNER JOIN retail.DimStore AS s ON fs.StoreKey = s.StoreKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimGeography AS g ON s.GeographyKey = g.GeographyKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimDate AS dd ON fs.DateKey = dd.DateKey
    WHERE g.ContinentName = 'North America'
    GROUP BY
        fs.DateKey,
        dd.NorthAmericaSeason
) AS d
GROUP BY d.NorthAmericaSeason
ORDER BY avg_daily_sales DESC
LIMIT 1
